lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill region, extending along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, particularly evident in the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Several discrete high-luminance blobs of varying sizes distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense population of small, high-luminance spots localized on the anterior and lateral surface of the left pectoral fin.
